questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships you have with Peter Warren or Wakeling Automotive. If you are a new car dealer, please specify any OEM agreements you have.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if there are not many alternatives to Peter Warren or Wakeling Automotive, or if one is a major supplier to, or customer of, competitors of the other.

Identify any material developments that have occurred in 2026 that have impacted competition between OEMs, or between car dealerships that you consider are relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Describe the extent to which Peter Warren’s Remedy Offer would address any concerns you have in relation to the Acquisition.

Provide your view on whether the two sites and eight dealerships that Peter Warren is proposing to divest are likely to attract a suitable purchaser, and the qualities a suitable purchaser would possess.

Provide your view on any factors that may impact effective implementation of the Remedy Offer e.g., undertaking drafting and any third-party consents required, including the process to transfer / relocate the dealerships to the Divestiture Business sites.
Provide any additional information or comments you consider relevant to the ACCC’s consideration of the Acquisition or Remedy Offer.
